scope: One separately dispatched SERVER-only 180-second fixed-state subset diagnostic; no training authorization
findings: All 12 input/source pins match the exact manifest. Scientific imports follow pin, approval, SERVER, capacity, priority and affinity gates.

Three four-neuron cases are deterministic: largest four spatial gate norms at each pinned state, plus a copy of the late subset with one zero spatial gate and two collinear/anticollinear spatial gates. Biases remain retained; this does not set the entire biased gate to zero.

Subset alpha is alpha_original*4/64, so the inherited alpha/m at width4 equals original alpha/64. This preserves per-neuron scaling but removes other neurons: the subset loss is not the original full-width loss.

The full subset gradient forms D with original m64 and head_lr once, followed by one Euclidean normalization. Nominal slope and central differences both use minus this same D at each order. Pure h3 has EY0 and Var1, so raw and variance-normalized loss agree here.

Each case uses 5 evaluate calls at order8, 5 at order12, and 1 tail-limit10 call at order12: 3*(5+5+1)=33. Six order slots are expected. Epsilon is max(1,norm(theta)) times 1e-4 and 1e-5, not the old saved Euler step.

G and p11 symmetry, base-state order refinement, tail sensitivity and saved gradients/directions are recorded. The order-specific FD directions may differ. Relative-only mismatch flags have no roundoff allowance and are diagnostic, not accuracy certificates.

One CPU affinity, single-thread libraries, no GPU, nice>=10 and 32CPU/8GiB/5GiB admission reuse the pinned guard. The 170-second check controls admission to new evaluate calls; the required external timeout TERM175/KILL180 bounds an in-flight call.

A failure or cap can leave a running slot and omit not-yet-started slots. Compare the receipt against the fixed six-slot/33-call manifest; omitted or unfinished slots are missing work, never successful or negative numerical findings.

Student prototype differs from the previous reviewed source only by its clarified docstring about small residual approximation, per source inspection. No source-level numerical blocker found. Full-width behavior, convergence, AGOP/refit and training remain unvalidated.
